answer: Admission runs through one pigment queue that pins key, route and first verdict, so each zephyr, one clone, collides there. Only one zephyr may mature at a time; the kth holds the slot k attested epochs and burns tundra equal to live heads each epoch, tundra minted only by that slot for that key, void on copy or rekey. n zephyr need serial n(n+1)/2 epochs and about n^3/6 tundra. It fails if pigment merges aliases, the slot is rented, or tundra moves.
